name: CBULKiT – Advanced Bulk Coupons For WooCommerce
author: ithemelandco

sections.description:
Managing WooCommerce coupons one by one is slow and inefficient — especially for stores running frequent promotions with many coupon codes.

CBULKiT – Advanced Bulk Coupons For WooCommerce gives you a spreadsheet-style editor where you can filter, edit, and update multiple coupons at once — saving you hours of repetitive work.

With capabilities like advanced filtering, scheduled bulk updates, and background processing, COUPEDIT is built for both small stores and large WooCommerce setups with many coupon codes.

Whether you need to adjust amounts, dates, usage limits, or coupon statuses, CBULKiT gives you full control with real time performance and reliability.

🚀 Why Choose CBULKiT?

✔️ Edit multiple WooCommerce coupons simultaneously
✔️ Spreadsheet-style interface for fast editing
✔️ Powerful filters to find exactly what you need
✔️ Schedule coupon updates for future changes
✔️ Background processing and Big Data support

Please check other videos in bulk coupons editing channel

Key Features

  • User friendly design
  • Filtering by all Coupon fields: title, category, taxonomy, …
  • Advanced bulk editing form: edit all woocommerce coupon fields in specific operands:
    • Append, prepend, replace for text fields: title and …
    • Increase, decrease for numeric fields
    • Calculator for decimal values
    • Date picker for date fields
    • Multiple selection: category, taxonomy, tag
    • And …
  • Show/Hide columns
  • Column manager:
    • Set color and BG color for columns
    • Set custom label for columns
  • Create new coupon
  • Duplicate coupons
  • Delete several coupons with one click
  • Search coupons by items
  • Inline Edit: edit values in separate types: numeric, text, date, checkbox and …
  • Save search form query
  • Add custom fields / taxonomy as columns, search field and bulk edit field
  • Import / Export
  • Binded editing: edit several coupon’s field at once.
  • History: Save all of change log beside of Undo / Redo: You can revert your changes too.
  • Sticky column: fix ID column
  • Change usage restriction field by field
  • Change usage limits field by field
  • Support all woocommerce coupon’s fields

Free vs Pro

🆓 Free Version

✅ Fetch All Coupons
✅ Support All Coupon Fields
✅ Import Coupons
✅ Export Coupons

⚠️ Powerful Search Form – Limited
⚠️ Advanced Bulk Edit – Limited
⚠️ Add Meta Fields – Limited
⚠️ History Management – Limited
⚠️ Undo / Redo – Limited
⚠️ Bind Edit – Limited

🟢 Perfect for small shops and basic coupon edits

🚀 Pro Version

✅ Fetch All Coupons
✅ Support All Coupon Fields
✅ Import Coupons
✅ Export Coupons

🟢 Powerful Search Form
🟢 Advanced Bulk Edit
🟢 Add Custom Meta Fields
🟢 History Management
🟢 Undo / Redo Changes
🟢 Bind Edit (Linked Editing)

⏱️ Scheduled Bulk Coupon Updates
⚙️ Background Processing for Heavy Operations
📊 Big Data Optimized for Large Coupon Sets

🔵 Ideal for stores with frequent promotions, large coupon sets, and automated workflows

Check demo version: Pro Version

Note: Below screenshots are from Pro Version.

External services

This plugin connects to a license server to activate the plugin and check for updates.
It sends the site admin’s email address and license key to iThemelandCo when the license is activated or when checking for updates. The server responds with activation status, update availability, or error messages.
This service is required to verify valid licenses and deliver updates.
This service is provided by “iThemelandCo”. http://ithemelandco.com/
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

e.g.

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/plugin-name directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. After Install and Activate this plugin a menu will be added in your admin menu named “iT Woo Coupons”
sections.faq:
How to check this plugin before purchasing that?

There are two ways to check the Bulk Coupons Editing for WooCommerce plugin before buying:

Build Test Drive
Build Test-Drive(Amin Demo) and work with plugins in a real environment. For this, Please go to plugin page and then click the Live Preview button to enter the plugin demo page. In the top bar that appears, click Launch Admin Demo. A popup will appear asking you to enter your email and submit the form. The relevant link will be sent to your email now.

What are the required systems for Bulk Coupons Editing for WooCommerce Plugin?

PHP compatibility: from 7.x
WordPress compatibility: from v5.x to the latest WordPress version.

Where can I see video tutorials?

Please check Bulk Coupons Editing for WooCommerce Plugin youtube channel

Where can I get the premium version of this plugin?

Please check Bulk Coupons Editing for WooCommerce Plugin

I need more information about this plugin

Please check the knowledge base

How I can translate Bulk Coupons Editing for WooCommerce to other languages?

You can use this plugin in any language, this means you can translate this plugin to another language.

There is a translate file in the “Language” folder as ‘.pot’ extension.

You can easily translate the plugin into the desired languages by using translation plugins such as WPML and Loco Translate.

Can we use this plugin on multiple sites?

Yes! As you know, Bulk Coupons Editing for WooCommerce is a premium product that is sold through the codecanyon store. For each purchase, you will be assigned a purchase code and you can use this purchase code on only one website, so to use the Bulk Coupons Editing for WooCommerce on your various websites, you need to separate license for each site.

What is your refund policy?

If you believe that you’ve bought the wrong product and the purchased product is useless, you can send a refund request for that. Within 30 days of purchase, iThemelandCo will Refund your money.

I have an idea, can I discuss it with you?

Please leave your message in our support system
